group.ja: 重力と長距離相互作用

summary.ja: 粒子を八分木にまとめ、遠方セルの質量モーメントで孤立重力を近似します。直接和と同じ軟化核で力誤差を比べられます。
summary.en: Approximate isolated particle gravity with an octree and cell moments; compare force error with the identical softened direct sum.

code_mapping_scope: Related chapter modules and test files; not a claim that each test covers every named method.

references.label: A hierarchical O(N log N) force-calculation algorithm (1986)
references.scope: Cited by the linked chapter; inspect its source-review notes before treating this as a method-specific derivation.

assumptions: A node containing the target is always opened; self-interaction is excluded
units: Dimensionless examples with G=1; retain the chosen length, mass and softening conventions.

limitations.ja: 静的な力の比較です。標的ごとの近似は厳密な対運動量保存を保証せず、相互作用数は実行時間ではありません。FMMやTreePMの実装ではありません。
limitations.en: Static force comparisons only. Target-wise approximation need not conserve pair momentum exactly; interaction counts are not timings. This is not an FMM or TreePM implementation.

metadata_review.level: chapter-linked; detailed method-specific curation in progress

assumptions_ja: 3次元の孤立した粒子系・正の質量
標的粒子を含むノードは必ず開き、自己相互作用を除外
units_ja: 無次元の例でG=1。長さ・質量・軟化長の規約を揃えて比較します。
boundary_conditions_ja: 孤立境界。周期境界ではありません。
